description: Drive to the nearest confirmed semantic track of a person and stop 1.2 m short of it. Needs semantic_layer_node (/costmap/semantic_tracks) and the global EKF. Standoff 1.2, not the 1.0 default: in the closed-loop rig a footprint-sized person holds the car ~0.11 m short at 1.0 (the MPC's w_obs term), outside object_reach_tol_m 0.10, so the move could not complete; at 1.2 it settles within 0.02 m.
